_comment: CANONICAL barangay reference data for Naga City. Single source of truth.
Do not edit the generated copies in comcen/ or barangayApp/ — edit this file

source.dataset: OCHA/HDX Common Operational Dataset — Philippines Subnational Administrative Boundaries
notes: Replaces an earlier synthetic dataset ("AI Forecasting System - Barangay
Boundaries (2025)") that had 33 interior holes — gaps enclosed by other
barangays, which cannot exist inside a city. The two largest sat between
Norte. This dataset has none: a 400x400 point-in-polygon sweep of the city
bounding box finds zero uncovered cells enclosed by covered ones.
bounding boxes): all 27 names match in both directions.
NAME NOTE: PSGC/COD record PH0501724027 as "San Francisco (Pob.)". This
file uses "San Francisco" because that string is the join key across the
border colours, the seeded risk_level rows, and the backend name list.
Renaming it requires changing all of those together.
source.borderColorNote: borderColorOrder preserves the hand-chosen emission order of BARANGAY_BORDER_COLORS (spreads similar hues apart so neighbouring barangays contrast). Lookup is by name, so order is cosmetic — but keeping it avoids a spurious diff.
